name: I Have Children
description: What is it like to raise children in Athens of 2024? Is there a good parenting manual? Sara and Michalis "have children" and now their life as a couple is in... another dimension. Their everyday life descends from the pink bubble into a hilarious "conspiracy", where the daily routine becomes an adventure. The couple's environment adapts to the new conditions and all together make life "with children". A life full of unexpected, explosive situations and lots of laughter. This comedy will debunk the myths of the exemplary parent, ideal spouse, successful career and perfect family.

videos.title: Changes
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara realize that having children means that for years you may not be able to have a complete conversation with your partner. They aim to go out on a date but this turns out to be much more difficult than they thought. An old acquaintance of Stavros comes to the fore again, while Ektoras and Ioanna decide to donate all of Maximilianos' toys.

videos.title: Chores
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara drown in the world of extra work that comes with children. Sara decides to return to work and asks for the help of those close to her. Michalis and Stavros undertake to do one of Tasos's schoolwork instead of him.

videos.title: Playground
videos.overview: The family spends their entire day at the playground. There, Michalis is confronted with a lie he has told, while Stella and Sara interact with the "hot dad" of the park. Stavros becomes a kid again, while Ioanna and Hector go on a search for a turtle...

videos.title: Grandpas and Grandmas
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara are forced to ask the grandparents for help. Antigoni and Stelios do their best to make them regret it. Michalis' dream of an interview with the Security Forces is crushed because of Tony. Sara tries to reason with her new bosses on the issue of expenses.

videos.title: Decluttering
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara realize that with children, you bring a lot more stuff into your home than you need. The family decides that they need to get rid of 50% of the "clutter" but when all their efforts fail, Stella is enlisted to help.

videos.title: Biggest fans
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara become their children's biggest supporters, and as a result, Hara participates in a painting exhibition that has an unexpected result, while Tasos finds a rather unconventional hobby. Michalis tries to find a way to look modern for a photo shoot of his work. Steph and Sophie are looking for a logo for a limited edition beer.

videos.title: Morning awakenings
videos.overview: Tasos causes trouble at school and the whole family has to find a way to wake up even earlier than usual. Sara tries to regain her lost energy through a special diet, while Michalis, with the help of Stavros, installs an alarm in the house for fear of being robbed.

videos.title: Trips
videos.overview: The family is getting ready to leave for a trip. Michalis tries to find a way to fit the luggage in the car, while Sara searches for Hara's lost toy . The unexpected arrivals of Stavros, Ioanna and Stelios create additional problems. Everything gets worse when Tasos goes missing.

videos.title: Personal moments
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to rekindle their sex life but all attempts go from bad to worse. Sara spends time with Hector and accidentally causes him to return to his old life on the day of his rebirth birthday party. Michalis and Stavros look for a hobby to spend time together but end up in a dead-end.

videos.title: Viruses
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to hide from the rest of the family that they are sick so as not to be banned from the annual family retreat at Hector and Ioanna's chalet. They seek medical advice from an elderly pediatrician, Mr. Charilaos. Sara tries to get by with a delayed clothing order, while Michalis tries to find the most enticing title for his article.

videos.title: Financials
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to find ways to save a little money this month. Their efforts to reduce expenses and increase income are not only not working, but are actually having the opposite effect, with the couple trying to at least stay within their monthly budget.

videos.title: Methods - Tricks - Techniques
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara realize that their children have taken the reigns of their lives and do everything they can to… get him back. At the same time, the whole group tries to go to a band's concert, but their plan is threatened by a punishment imposed by Michalis. Hector takes it upon himself to take the children to an escape room.

videos.title: Anniversary
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara are looking for a way to "get rid" of their children, after deciding that just this year they must celebrate their anniversary. However, a wrong move by Michalis creates tension between them and causes fights. They need to relive a moment from the past to come together again.

videos.title: Physical condition
videos.overview: Michalis suffers a lumbago after a game with Chara, and is in danger of missing the final of the bowling tournament he has with Stavros. Sara realizes that her physical condition is not what it used to be and tries to sabotage her participation in the 5K Marathon with Chenua.

videos.title: Beautiful things
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara fall in love with an expensive carpet and decide to buy it. Knowing that their children are destroying all the beautiful things in the house, they exhaust every effort to prevent them. At the same time, Michalis becomes addicted to a social networking platform and Sara makes the big decision to get a manicure.

videos.title: Hangover
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara wake up with a hangover and can't survive at home with the kids. All their efforts to keep them busy fall flat, while a family dinner comes to make things even more difficult.

videos.title: Personal Time
videos.overview: Sara realizes that she no longer has any personal time and decides to find a hobby so she can unwind. Michalis agrees to a professional project, which Tony assigns to him without his knowledge, and together with Stavros they embark on a "blue" adventure.

videos.title: Getaway
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara head off for a weekend getaway at a beautiful boutique hotel, where Michalis needs to write a review. However, their trip takes a turn for the worse when Michalis realizes his review will have to be negative, and Sara struggles to enjoy herself because she misses the kids

videos.title: Yes Day
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara agree that they no longer want to forbid everything to their children and decide to give them a "yes day", during which they cannot say "no" to anything they ask. Their plan does not go well at all, exactly as they expected.

videos.title: Diet
videos.overview: Sara tries to teach her kids to eat more vegetables, but her method backfire. Michalis tries to lower his cholesterol while Sara tries to get rid of a masseuse with magical hands...

videos.title: Sleep
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to find a way to get their kids to sleep in their own beds at night... Tony loses "Urbanic" at cards and Michalis and Stavros try to win it back. Ioanna recruits a famous influencer to promote her NGO, but she's in for a huge surprise...

videos.title: Party
videos.overview: It's Chara's birthday and Michalis and Sara try to organize the party she requested. When everything goes wrong, an unexpected solution comes along that will exceed Chara's expectations.

videos.title: Fears
videos.overview: When Chara's favorite cartoon character comes to Greece and Tasos decides to go to school alone, two big fears are awakened for Michalis and Sara. Tony invites himself to Michalis' house for dinner.

videos.title: Christmas
videos.overview: This Christmas, the family is called upon to find out if Santa Claus exists, what the true spirit of Christmas is, why some people hate Christmas, and how difficult it is to feed all this world with Christmas food.

videos.title: Swearing
videos.overview: Tasos is expelled from school for cursing to his teacher. Michalis and Sara decide they need to find a way to make sure it doesn't happen again. Stavros and Michalis look for a third person for the board game night, while Sara is forced to go out with her colleagues so she doesn't feel left out.

videos.title: Quarrels
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara are going through a period where they fight frequently and try to find ways to reduce it. Sara and Ioanna are worried that their mother is seriously ill. Stavros tries to get Michalis to get over Sara by faithfully following a list of steps.

videos.title: Private schools
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara are informed that Tasos is not doing well in his studies and they decide to send him to a private school. Michalis wants to prevent Stavros from renting a studio that is vacant in their apartment building.

videos.title: Sleep over
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis try to "train" their children to behave properly at the sleepover that will take place at Ioanna and Hector's house. Stella doesn't know how to behave with her new partner's child and asks Sara for help. Stavros accepts a very good job offer at another company.

videos.title: Nannies
videos.overview: Toni assigns Michalis and Stavros to organize a party for the tenth anniversary of "Urbanic". He reveals to them that his great love is Fay Skorda and that he would like her to attend the event. Michalis and Sara are looking for a nanny to look after the children so they can go to the party, which seems to be extremely difficult. Sara is faced with very unpleasant news, which Mr. Stelios confides in her.

videos.title: Valentine
videos.overview: Saint Valentine's night finds Michalis and Sara having nothing to talk about, Hector and Ioanna disagreeing, and Stavros and Stella having a very strange date that takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Screens
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis realize that their children are spending too much time in front of screens and decide to limit it. However, they have not foreseen the consequences of their decision. Stavros and Michalis practice for a game show in which their best friends participate, while Sara and Ioanna sort through a box of family heirlooms.

videos.title: Family traditions
videos.overview: Michalis decides to make Tsiknopempti a family tradition, just like it was in his own house. Sara spends more time with Stavros, as a result of a bet. Hector and Ioanna deviate and do things outside of their usual routine.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Stavros has an operation on his eye and Michalis hosts him in the family's house. Stella's new boyfriend asks to meet her friends. Stella is forced to introduce him to Sara. However, he has other plans that will put the whole group in an awkward position.

videos.title: Lies
videos.overview: Pixie goes missing and Michalis and Sara lie to Chara about her whereabouts. Sara enlists Antigoni to help with a case that has arisen in Chenua. Michalis must interview a singer of a new musical genre.

videos.title: Teachers
videos.overview: Michalis tries to teach Chara how to ride a bike. Sara is determined to make Tasos understand and love math. Stef and Sofi change their behavior and adapt so as not to lose a new partnership with a shipping company.

videos.title: Big decisions
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara begin to seriously consider moving because their house no longer fits them. Ioanna is faced with a "no" from Maximilian for the first time. Tony and Michalis switch places for the sake of a woman who has entered Tony's life.

videos.title: Pets
videos.overview: Sara rescues a stray dog from the street and brings it home. Michalis reaches his limit with Tony and decides to quit. Sara tries to stop Ektoras from making a new beer flavor for Chenua.

videos.title: Referees
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try in every possible way to get their children to stop fighting. Stavros unexpectedly falls in love. Sara is once again faced with a bet made by her mother and sister.

videos.title: Chauffeurs
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara spend all Saturday in the car, driving the kids to various activities. This turns out to be a good opportunity to spend some time together. Ioanna and Ektoras visit a psychic who has a very bad prediction for them.

videos.title: Setbacks
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara's plan to do nothing all day is thwarted by a series of unexpected circumstances. The day ends with gastroenteritis, lice, tetanus shots, dislocated shoulders, and an allergic reaction.

videos.title: Pocket money
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis believe it's time for Tasos to start getting pocket money so he can learn to manage them. Michalis wants to help his father get over the loss of a very good friend. Sara tries to find the right partner for Stella through a dating app.

videos.title: Grooming
videos.overview: Sara, after pressure from Stella, Antigoni and Ioanna, decides to take care of herself, which she has neglected. Tasos tries to convince his parents to buy him a cell phone, like all his friends have. Michalis and Stavros come face to face with a new employee at Urbanic.

videos.title: Invitations to parties
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara have a lot of invitations to kids' parties on a single Saturday, and they try to see which ones they can go to. Michalis' favorite journalist is giving a speech on the same day, and Sara tries to stop Stef and Sofi from placing their beer in the wrong places.

videos.title: Good example
videos.overview: Michalis realizes that Tasos is not treating him well and is afraid of not having the same relationship with him that he has with his father. Sara tries to convince Chara to pack her clothes and ends up buying a large wardrobe that she has to assemble herself. Antigoni, due to plumbing problems, goes to stay with Ioanna for two days.

videos.title: Cleanup Day
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara decide to do a cleaning of the house, but they have a hard time with the kids in their arms. Toni asks Michalis to interview a Hollywood legend who came to Greece, while Ioanna and Ektoras assume that Sara is pregnant again.

videos.title: Godparents
videos.overview: Michalis decides to find Tasos' missing godfather, while Sara tries to tell her mother that this Easter they will be going on vacation somewhere else and not at their cottage. Stelios does crafts with his grandchildren for the first time, which he seems to enjoy more than usual.

videos.title: Grand plans
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara decide to continue a grand plan that they had neglected because of the children. Thus, a podcast about economics and a book of wisdom, to read on the toilet, become the focus of their interest. However, those around them constantly put obstacles in their way.

videos.title: Sports
videos.overview: Sara tries to train Tasos intensively in basketball in order to get him on the school team. Michalis struggles to convince his father to take blood pressure pills, as the doctor prescribed, and Stavros is asked to create the new website for Chenua.

videos.title: Questions
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis struggle to answer their children's strange questions and invent various ways to avoid appearing irrelevant in their eyes. Stef and Sofi look for a work environment that won't put them under pressure, while Stavros falls victim to a stalker.

videos.title: Opinions
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis learn that Tasos is being harassed by a classmate at school. They decide to handle it themselves, but their surroundings won't let them. At the same time, there is a toilet crisis at Urbanic while Chenua is turned into a meeting place for the entire neighborhood by Stef and Sofi.

videos.title: Playdates
videos.overview: Tasos arranged a playdate with a friend at home. Sara and Michalis prepare a management plan. Ioanna is nominated for an award for her charity work. Tony suffers from insomnia and is forced to sleep at the office, which leads him to ask Michalis for help.

videos.title: Patience
videos.overview: Michalis realizes that he is losing his temper with the kids and tries to find ways to change it. A new employee arrives at Chenua and refuses to do the initiation ritual that Stef and Sofi impose on him. Stavros is once again disappointed by a woman he likes.

videos.title: Heroic acts
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to convince their children to get blood tests, but Sara's fear of blood draws makes things worse. Ioanna and Ektoras host an old friend of his who gets them into trouble. Michalis is forced to write an article about Eurovision without having any idea about the subject.

videos.title: Good manners
videos.overview: Michalis tries hard to teach his children good manners, but he has a hard time. Ektoras has taken up filmmaking as a new hobby and wants to make a tribute video to Ioanna. Michalis and Stavros are forced to immerse themselves in football in order to write an article that Toni has requested.

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: The family car starts to have problems, but Michalis refuses to part with it. Sara decides to spend more time with the kids cooking, while Ektoras and Ioanna receive a visit that will upset their family.

videos.title: Activities
videos.overview: Tasos and Hara ask their parents to do more extracurricular activities, as do their friends, and end up with a packed schedule. Stavros misinterprets something Toni says, which stresses Michalis out, while Sara faces a work crisis when Stef and Sofi stop talking to each other.

videos.title: Anxiety
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara realize that they have started to pass their anxiety to their children and decide to find ways to stop it. Stavros unexpectedly becomes the hero of the office, while Mr. Stelios decides to go on a date with a woman.

videos.title: Selective memory
videos.overview: After a highly episodic day at the beach, Michalis and Sara realize that they probably have a selective memory and decide to only remember the good things.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Tasos starts hanging out with a new classmate, who causes various problems, and Michalis and Sara look for ways to reason him. Stella quits her job and looks for ways to keep busy, while Stavros goes viral with his outfit.

videos.title: Retreats
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis decide not to give in to their children's constant requests and are faced with unexpected consequences. Toni and Stavros try to get rid of a ghost from the office. Michalis searches the whole house for his lucky socks.

videos.title: Super market
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis realize they have to go to the supermarket because they have run out of essentials at home. They decide to take the children with them, to introduce them to the idea of proper consumption. When everything else fails, Stavros is enlisted to help them.

videos.title: Spontaneity
videos.overview: Family decides to have a picnic in the park, but everything goes wrong. Stavros meets the love of his life, Stella seeks to get closer to her general manager, while Ioanna and Ektoras try to do a proper spring photoshoot.

videos.title: School trips
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis have to decide which of them will follow Tasos on his school field trip. Stef and Sofi prepare their acceptance speech, while Ioanna and Ektoras have to deal with a rejection from Maximilianos.

videos.title: Parallel universes
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara imagine their lives as different parents and try to understand how they would treat their children if they were different people, if they lived in different times, or if they had... superpowers.

videos.title: News
videos.overview: The Politi family – Michalis, Sara, Tasos and Chara – returns with a vengeance. With them, the ever-critical grandmother Antigoni, the strict kyr-Stelios, but also Ioanna with Ektoras and their son, Maximilianos. The puzzle is completed by the best friends, Stella and Stavros, Toni, the eccentric boss of Urbanic, as well as Sara’s Gen Z employers, Sofi and Stef. What news does the Politis family have to share with us?

videos.title: Night Time
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara implement an ambitious plan: to put the kids to bed early to have some precious time for the two of them. However, their mission proves to be more difficult than they expected. Sara tries to get Stella to reveal details about a secret she has, while Stavros faces off against his nemesis, Alexis from the accounting department.

videos.title: Denial
videos.overview: After yet another "spectacular" accident of Tasos, Michalis and Sara choose the certainty of denial: they stubbornly refuse to accept that their son is prone to blows. At the same time, Ioanna and Ektoras end up at the psychologist's office looking for answers, while Stavros is overcome with panic when an app on his phone warns him of an impending major earthquake.

videos.title: Children at Work
videos.overview: A strike disrupts family planning and Michalis and Sara are forced to take the children to their workplaces. Little Chara unexpectedly becomes Toni's "lucky charm" and is proclaimed Chenua's creative guru. At the same time, Tasos undergoes the "training" of Stef and Sofi and brings Urbanic one step closer to total collapse.

videos.title: Memories
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis face the existential anxiety of every parent: "What will our children remember from their childhood?" In their attempt to build the perfect family album, they realize that the best moments are not planned. Ioanna and Ektoras try to discover the source of Maximilianos' happiness. At the same time, Stavros accompanies Stella to the doctor for a routine ultrasound, but ends up making a revelation about his own health that upsets him.

videos.title: Promises
videos.overview: "We'll see" and "starting on Monday" are not the solution, as Sara and Michalis decide to break the habit of unfulfilled promises. Their attempt to be honest with Tasos and Chara proves to be a demanding challenge. Meanwhile, Ioanna makes the big decision to get a job, upsetting the family's balance. Finally, Stavros, amidst his insecurity, sets a goal to convince Toni to get health insurance.

videos.title: Carnival
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis get into carnival mood and, while the house is filled with costumes, they struggle to find the perfect ones that will make them stand out. Stef and Sofi, true to their unconventional nature, declare themselves completely opposed to the philosophy of the carnival. Ioanna and Ektoras's grandiose plans for an impressive evening are canceled in the most episodic way. The party culminates when Stavros and Stella, instead of the dance floor, end up in the hospital's Emergency Room.

videos.title: Parents and Guardians Association
videos.overview: Sara decides to take on the Parents and Guardians Association, with a sacred goal: to finally get Tasos' school a working refrigerator. At the same time, Tonι makes a surprise move and hires Mr. Stelios at Urbanic, creating an unexpected dynamic in the office, while Ioanna enlists Stavros's skills to create an application dedicated to the Lycabettus tortoise.

videos.title: Children's Lies
videos.overview: When Chara is caught lying, Michalis and Sara embark on a "truth-revealing" operation that has unexpected consequences. Stavros and Michalis try to figure out why Toni is locked in his office, assuming the worst. Meanwhile, an old childhood friend of Ioanna's appears, bringing with her memories, but also unexpected things.

videos.title: Cleaning Lady
videos.overview: A cleaning lady seems like a godsend, but for Michalis it's the beginning of a new ordeal. While Sara can't wait for a bit of rest, the obsessively tidy Michalis is pushed to the brink of paranoia. At the same time, Stef and Sofi are trying to create the ultimate "inspiring" Chenua moments for the most Gen Z beer out there. Stavros has a full-blown FOMO crisis, convinced that whenever something fun happens at the office, he's always the one who misses it.

videos.title: Babies
videos.overview: Stella persistently asks Sara and Michalis for advice, forcing them to open “Pandora’s box”: the time when they themselves had babies. Through a lively flashback, they share the raw truth about diaper changes reminiscent of “Mission: Impossible,” the feeding battle that always ends in a chaotic retreat, and the “Holy Grail” of parenthood: sleep. A dive into memories that proves that if you emerge unscathed from the first months of becoming a parent, then you can achieve anything.

videos.title: Gifts
videos.overview: A gift from Ioanna to Chara causes an incredible uproar in Pagrati. Sara and Michalis start a race to make it disappear before their young daughter sees it, at the same time that Ioanna also tries to get it back. In the midst of it all, Michalis is confronted with a big secret from his past.

videos.title: Safety
videos.overview: A random incident makes Michalis see his life flash before his eyes, leading him to a sudden obsession with life insurance. At the same time, Sara decides to attend first aid seminars, but her performance proves... threatening for the "victim". Meanwhile, Ioanna and Ektoras apply a new, revolutionary pedagogical method to Maximilianos: they try to make him bored, believing that boredom breeds creativity. The result, of course, proves them wrong.

videos.title: Deadlines
videos.overview: Every parent's nightmare becomes reality: Michalis and Sara miss the payment deadline for Chara's ballet class, resulting in her being dropped from the lessons. Meanwhile, Stavros is frantically preparing for a school reunion, hoping to impress an old classmate. Sara and Ioanna take their rivalry onto the tennis courts, and their competition spirals completely out of control.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: The big moment has arrived: Tasos stays home alone for the first time. Sara, though in a state of panic, summons all her composure in order to show him she trusts him. Meanwhile, Stavros decides to give his appearance a radical rebranding, starting naturally with his wardrobe. Having ignored his son Michalis's efforts for so long, Stelios is convinced by a friend to make a genuine attempt to open up and express his feelings.

videos.title: Video Games
videos.overview: Tasos sinks deep into the world of video games, and the Politis family declares... a full mobilization to bring him back to reality, with rather questionable results. At the Urbanic office, Michalis and Stavros launch their own "crusade" with the sole mission of getting their hands on the new ergonomic chairs. Meanwhile, at Ioanna and Ektoras' home, a new painting brings a breath of high art and refined aesthetics.

videos.title: Stereotypes
videos.overview: Can a color trigger a family crisis? When Stelios convinces Tasos to give up his favorite t-shirt because it's pink, Sara and Michalis take on the difficult task of breaking down gender stereotypes. Meanwhile, Ektoras applies the most advanced self-improvement techniques to free Stavros from work-related stress, while the family's new neighbors introduce themselves in the loudest way possible: as incorrigible party animals.

videos.title: Sibling Rivalry
videos.overview: Tasos and Chara are not on speaking terms following a fight, and their parents employ every diplomatic skill they have to broker a reconciliation before the situation spirals permanently out of control. At the same time, Stavros feels the first arrows of love for someone "off-limits": Toni's sister! Stef and Sofi decide to transform the Chenua office into a tropical zone, bringing nature into the workplace.

videos.title: Stuck Indoors
videos.overview: A major storm traps the Politis family at home, turning the living room into a testing ground for their nerves and creativity. Meanwhile, Ioanna and Ektoras feel threatened by their home's "smart" technology. Stella finds herself cooped up at home, with Stavros for company — along with a stranger she happened to meet at the playground. Will the storm outside prove less dangerous than the awkward cohabitation within?

videos.title: Arrangements
videos.overview: A solo night out is never a straightforward affair. Sara and Michalis launch a relentless points-scoring competition to decide which one of them has finally earned the right to leave the house without the rest of the family. At the same time, Stavros, as the ultimate market research expert, takes it upon himself to help Stella choose the perfect pram — a mission that turns out to be far more complicated than he ever imagined. Meanwhile, at Chenua, Stef and Sofi are struggling to come up with the most impactful TikTok Challenge for their Gen Z beer.

videos.title: Second Children
videos.overview: The classic guilt that haunts every parent comes back to haunt Sara when she realizes she hasn't devoted the same amount of time to her second child, Chara. She therefore decides to put together the ultimate photo album for her — with results that border on the excessive. At the office, Stavros makes it his mission to create a personal "sanctuary" for Michalis within Urbanic, a space where his friend can breathe away from everyone and everything. At the same time, Stef and Sofi set a new, ambitious goal: to secure an international wellness certification for Chenua.

videos.title: Easter
videos.overview: The Politis family, along with relatives and friends, decides to seek some peace and quiet at Antigoni's countryside home over the Easter holidays. However, as is often the case, nothing goes according to plan and the unexpected turns out to be the only constant. Maximilanos develops an unprecedented "addiction" to Easter sweets, while his parents, Ioanna and Ektoras, stubbornly refuse to take part in any of the traditional customs. Meanwhile, Stavros and Stella manage to get completely lost on the way to their destination. Amid this climate of general chaos, Sara and Michalis are confronted with a shocking possibility that will make them see the holidays in a whole new light.

videos.title: Dentist
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis struggle to convince Tasos to sit in the dentist's chair, as his toothache leaves no room for further delay. Michalis and Stavros are set to appear as extras in their favorite crime series. Meanwhile, Ioanna, ever faithful to celebrity trends, takes it upon herself — in her own flamboyant way — to organize a spectacular gender reveal party for Stella.

videos.title: Sweets
videos.overview: A new rule is imposed at home: Tasos and Chara must stay away from sweets of all kinds for 48 hours. Sara and Michalis do their best to enforce it, but the mission proves impossible. At Urbanic, Stavros takes charge of the office's technological upgrade, on the hunt for a company to replace the ancient computers. Finally, Ektoras watches his financial plans crumble when the fund in which he had invested all his savings… freezes.

videos.title: Foreign Languages
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara's guilt goes through the roof when they realize that Tasos is falling behind his peers in foreign languages and decide he must start English lessons. Meanwhile at Urbanic, Toni demands more experiential articles with clickbait titles, and Michalis, with Stavros's help, tries to rise to the challenge. Finally, Ioanna pulls a surprise and asks for Sara's help for the very first time.

videos.title: Pride
videos.overview: The drama teacher praises Tasos' acting talent, sending waves of pride through Sara and Michalis, who now see their son as a future star. Meanwhile, Chara, determined to right a wrong at school, calls in the big guns: her grandmother and the family lawyer. At Chenua, Sara tries to win the attention of Stef and Sofi by speaking their Gen Z language — that is, through a video.

videos.title: New Friends
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis experience the rare luck of meeting two other parents with whom they seem to be a perfect match. The hope that they have finally found their "new friends" soon evaporates. Toni wins a new business venture in a card game and appoints Michalis and Stavros as those responsible for running it. Antigoni decides to retire.

videos.title: Career
videos.overview: Sara struggles to turn down a tempting job offer from a major multinational company, but saying no proves far more complicated than expected. At the same time, Antigoni and Stelios fall victim to a con artist, throwing the whole family into turmoil. Meanwhile, Stavros and Michalis realize in the most comical way that the symptoms they have been feeling have a name: it's the classic midlife crisis, and it's knocking at their door.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis suspect that Tasos and Chara are hiding something important from them and mount an entire operation to find out what it is. In their effort to get to the bottom of it, they enlist the help of friends and relatives, but the plan ends in complete chaos!

videos.title: Advices
videos.overview: Tasos has grown up and is getting ready for his first flirtation! Sara and Michalis try to be the cool parents who give perfect romantic advice, without becoming overbearing. At the same time, Ioanna and Ektoras feel increasingly shut out by their social circle, while Stavros decides to take legal action against a company and enlists Antigoni to help him win the court battle.

videos.title: Guilts
videos.overview: Sara is confronted with the most classic of parental guilt: she feels she isn't spending as much quality time with Chara as she would like. Meanwhile at Chenua, Stef and Sofi task Michalis with writing an appealing article about their new flavor. At the same time, Maximilanos' birthday is approaching and Ioanna wants to throw the greatest party her son has ever had.

videos.title: Excuses
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara use the children's commitments as an excuse to avoid Stavros, Stef and Sofi, but it backfires. Meanwhile, Stavros and Toni kick off an epic board game tournament, while Antigoni and Stelios try to make sense of the unexpected results of Tasos' career aptitude test.

videos.title: I Have Parents
videos.overview: In this special episode, the camera switches sides! Tasos and Chara become the narrators of the story and share with us their own perspective on their parents. With the disarming honesty that only children possess, they tell us about the difficulties, the quirks and the challenge of growing up… your parents. A different, tender and thoroughly enjoyable look at the everyday life of the Politis family.

videos.title: Levels
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara hatch imaginative schemes to get Tasos and Chara to study on their own, hoping to advance to the next "level" of parenthood. Meanwhile, Stavros is utterly convinced that a woman has put a curse on him. Finally, Stella is confronted with a very unpleasant surprise at her workplace.

videos.title: Joint Decisions
videos.overview: Responsibility for every unlikely question or demand from the children gets passed around like a hot potato between Michalis and Sara. The two of them deploy every possible excuse to avoid committing to Chara and Tasos' wild wishes, but the big question remains: how much longer will this trick keep working in the Politis household before the plan dissolves into glorious chaos?

videos.title: Mysteries
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis try to solve a series of mysteries they discover around their home upon returning from a night out. Along the way, they find that relatives and friends are all tangled up in the story, each one holding a vital clue to solving the puzzle.

videos.title: Environment
videos.overview: In the Politis family home, one "green" activity follows another with one single purpose: to raise Tasos and Chara's awareness about environmental protection. At the same time in Ekali, Ektoras is thrilled by the inspiration his muse generously bestows upon him. Meanwhile at Urbanic, Stavros opens up an online front against readers who are leaving negative comments on one of Michalis's articles.

videos.title: Mistakes
videos.overview: Michalis and Sara try to teach Chara that mistakes are part of life, but their efforts hit one obstacle after another. At the same time, Toni, having already dabbled in gambling and clickbait titles for Urbanic, decides to take the next step and try his luck in politics.

videos.title: Birth
videos.overview: Sara recounts, with plenty of humor, her experiences giving birth to the two Politis children. Through flashbacks, viewers relive the funniest moments from the past, leading up to the moment Stella brings the newest member of the family into the world.

videos.title: Last Times
videos.overview: Sara and Michalis make an important decision about how they'll spend their summer, after talks with family and friends, in an episode full of emotion and farewells.
